# llm-actuators

> LLM-first toolchain — hands, eyes, legs, and fingers for an LLM session. 34 public repos: single-purpose tools that let an LLM act on real systems (devices, processes, files, other agents), plus the libraries, iOS components, and specs that support them. This file is the canonical entrypoint to the org.

## What this is

Every tool in this org is something an LLM uses to do work in the world. Each binary is sterile — primitives only, no domain verbs. Domain knowledge lives in the LLM, not the tool.

The org holds **34 public repos**: **32 toolchain/content repos** (the tools below, their libraries, iOS components, and specs) plus **2 org-infra repos** (`.github` — the org profile; `llm-actuators.github.io` — the Pages landing site).

If you are an LLM session opening this org for the first time, read this file end-to-end. It is short on purpose.

## The fleet

The tools an LLM session invokes directly.

| Binary | Role | Repo |
|---|---|---|
| `ddb` | Android device control (tap/swipe/type/screenshot/install/logcat) | [ddb](https://github.com/llm-actuators/ddb) |
| `idb` | iOS device control (same surface, physical devices via WDA) | [idb](https://github.com/llm-actuators/idb) |
| `wdb` | Browser control via Chrome DevTools Protocol | [wdb](https://github.com/llm-actuators/wdb) |
| `vdb` | Visual debug bridge — cross-platform drift + region matrix | [vdb](https://github.com/llm-actuators/vdb) |
| `fdb` | Figma frame extraction into the shared semantic schema | [fdb](https://github.com/llm-actuators/fdb) |
| `switchboard` | File-based pub/sub for multi-LLM coordination (ships `switchboard-ui`) | [switchboard](https://github.com/llm-actuators/switchboard) |
| `recruit` | Mid-session teammate spawner — splits tmux, joins same wire (ships `dismiss` + `idle-scout`) | [recruit](https://github.com/llm-actuators/recruit) |
| `token-monitor` | Session token usage alarm before context wipes | [token-monitor](https://github.com/llm-actuators/token-monitor) |
| `compact-self` | TUI compactor — agent triggers its own `/compact` | [compact-self](https://github.com/llm-actuators/compact-self) |
| `remote-control` | Expose the session to the Claude iOS app over VPN | [remote-control](https://github.com/llm-actuators/remote-control) |
| `burn` | Fleet-wide token-burn aggregator — GREEN/AMBER/RED across all seats | [burn](https://github.com/llm-actuators/burn) |
| `todo` | Priority-aware Markdown task ledger for agent cohorts | [todo](https://github.com/llm-actuators/todo) |
| `device-claim` | Atomic per-device mutex for concurrent agent sessions | [device-claim](https://github.com/llm-actuators/device-claim) |
| `resources` | Device/sim/emulator inventory across the fleet | [resources](https://github.com/llm-actuators/resources) |
| `actuators-doctor` | Fleet-wide health check for the org's binaries | [actuators-doctor](https://github.com/llm-actuators/actuators-doctor) |
| `fleet-tui` | Read-only terminal dashboard for a multi-agent fleet | [fleet-tui](https://github.com/llm-actuators/fleet-tui) |
| `gate` | Workflow state-machine enforcer wired into Claude Code hooks | [workflows](https://github.com/llm-actuators/workflows) |
| `tctl` | Toolchain control — preflight, suite, doc authority | [tctl](https://github.com/llm-actuators/tctl) |
| `claude-sandbox` | macOS Seatbelt profile + escape hatch (`nosandbox`) | [claude-sandbox](https://github.com/llm-actuators/claude-sandbox) |
| `skill-router` | PreToolUse-hook rules engine for skill enforcement | [skill-router](https://github.com/llm-actuators/skill-router) |
| `substrate` | Skill ecosystem CLI — enroll repos, deploy hooks, validate | [substrate](https://github.com/llm-actuators/substrate) |

Some repos ship more than one binary. `switchboard` also ships `switchboard-ui` (the ratatui chat client). `recruit` also ships `dismiss` (kill a recruited seat) and `idle-scout` (cron-fired cull-candidate scanner). `workflows` ships the `gate` binary. `fleet-tooling` ships a set of read-only fleet observability helpers (`fleet-digest` + its renderer, `idle-worktree`, `review-gen`).

## Libraries and supporting repos

| Repo | Role |
|---|---|
| [semantic-schema](https://github.com/llm-actuators/semantic-schema) | Shared Rust crate — the canonical semantic-UI wire format that ties `ddb`, `idb`, `fdb`, and `vdb` together |
| [semantic-agent-flutter](https://github.com/llm-actuators/semantic-agent-flutter) | Debug-only in-process HTTP agent for Flutter apps (sibling of the Android/iOS agents inside `ddb/agent/` and `idb/agent/`) |
| [idle-work](https://github.com/llm-actuators/idle-work) | Rust library + `idle-checkpoint` CLI — checkpoint + interrupt-safety primitives for long background jobs |
| [fleet-tooling](https://github.com/llm-actuators/fleet-tooling) | Read-only fleet observability & background-work helpers; reads its project topology from config |
| [hooks](https://github.com/llm-actuators/hooks) | Lifecycle-hook templates (session-start, post-compact) + an ARCHITECTURE.md documenting the enforcement layer, abstracted |
| [specs](https://github.com/llm-actuators/specs) | Example TOML config schemas for the toolchain's soft-gates |
| [WebDriverAgent](https://github.com/llm-actuators/WebDriverAgent) | Fork of the Facebook WDA, driven by iOS device control |
| [device-control-ios](https://github.com/llm-actuators/device-control-ios) | Support repo that pins/vendors the WDA revision `idb` builds against |
| [switchboard-ios](https://github.com/llm-actuators/switchboard-ios) | Native SwiftUI iOS client for the switchboard wire |
| [visual-qa](https://github.com/llm-actuators/visual-qa) | Cross-platform device-automation framework overview (properties, not screenshots, as source of truth) |

## Where to go next

- [repos.md](repos.md) — full map of all 34 repos: binary vs library vs iOS component vs docs, language, status
- [binaries.md](binaries.md) — one paragraph per binary: what it does, how to invoke, where the README lives
- [device-control.md](device-control.md) — common surface across `ddb`/`idb`/`wdb` (shared verbs, flag style, exit codes, output format)
- [agent-contract.md](agent-contract.md) — HTTP contract every in-app semantic-agent implements
- [walker-accessibility.md](walker-accessibility.md) — app-side a11y obligations so the walker can find elements (SwiftUI gotchas, off-viewport carousels, app-side fix vs toolchain widening)
- [mock-corpus.md](mock-corpus.md) — mock envelope shape, per-TC overlay variants, stateful mutation side-effects
- [schema.md](schema.md) — semantic-schema overview (the agent payload)
- [conventions.md](conventions.md) — release discipline (tags, CHANGELOGs, ADRs)

## Canonical deep references (in source repos)

- `tctl/docs/` — toolchain doc authority: ADRs, tech-debt ledger (180+ entries), epics, gaps, getting-started
- `tctl/docs/llms.txt` — tctl-binary entry point (deeper than this file)
- `tctl/docs/agent-porting-guide.md` — authoritative agent contract
- `tctl/docs/tech-debt.md` — search before adding any new mechanism

## What this org is NOT

- Not a framework. Each tool is a single binary you call.
- Not a runtime. The LLM is the runtime; tools are effectors.
- Not human-first. Humans can use these, but every doc assumes the consumer is a model.
